This is Audi’s new A6 Allroad. It’s got the practicality of an estate, the widebody design of an RS6, air suspension that’ll raise the ride height, plus chunky off-road cladding too. All that and it’s not a tall and heavy SUV either. In short, it’s a mega all-rounder, able to do almost anything, so might it be the best car Audi currently makes? To find out, we put it against Audi’s equally new Q7, both on the road and off it…
Audi A6 Allroad & Audi Q7
Tom Ford
